label_semantics.entry_anchor: signal day close decision, next calendar trading day open entry
label_semantics.entry_fill: evaluated after ranking from raw next-day open, suspension state, and the configured exchange-tick limit rule
label_semantics.earliest_exit: path day 2 (T+1 after the next-open entry day)
label_semantics.exit_fill: planned close exit defers to the first observed, status-valid, non-suspended, non-delisted day whose raw close is above the tick-rounded down limit
label_semantics.exit_retry_window: prediction remains 60 days; exit may defer for 20 additional trading days
label_semantics.unresolved_exit: after the retry window recover 0.000000 of entry notional before costs
label_semantics.future_ohlc_path: OHLC returns are relative to signal_day_close; price adjustment=back_adjust.
label_semantics.future_ohlcva_path: OHLC returns are relative to signal_day_close; volume and amount are log-relative to trailing 20 trading days ending on signal date.
label_semantics.suspended_path: explicit suspension days carry the last adjusted close with zero volume/amount only when suspension_fill=carry_adjusted_close; tradable remains false
label_semantics.future_mask_view: for signal index d, future observed/tradable masks are masks[d+1:d+1+forward_days] transposed by symbol
label_semantics.path_trade_value_v2: derived from next calendar trading day open entry even when price_anchor=today_close

scope.name: mutable_current_listed_mainboard_permanent_non_st_store
scope.universe: Current listed Shanghai/Shenzhen main-board A shares excluding every security permanently registered after an ST or delisting-period trigger.
